answer: Unrepeatable Challenge Derivation. Each agent identity must solve a fresh, randomly seeded proof-of-work whose seed includes the requester's prior output hash, so the puzzle cannot be precomputed or copied. Solutions are committed with a quartz timestamp and verified by independent nodes. To sustain N identities, an attacker must forge distinct valid solutions continuously, paying ongoing compute per identity; replaying any prior solution fails. Marble-like immutability of the challenge ledger blocks reuse.
